subject: Initial privacy agreement template & scope check for SecurePay
messages:
From: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@securepay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LegalOps SecurePay <legalops@securepay.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Request: DPA template + subprocessors + EU transfer approach

Hi Sofia,

We're kicking off procurement for SecurePay's plans to integrate Redwood's hosted API into our payment risk workflows. Our legal team asked me to request: (1) the latest Redwood DPA template, (2) an inventory of current subprocessors and their locations, and (3) a short note on how Redwood handles EU->US transfers (SCCs, EU gateway, or other).

Can you send the DPA we should start with and note whether you prefer DocuSign or AdobeSign for execution? Our timeline: we'd like to complete contracting by the end of next week if possible.

I've attached our vendor intake checklist (SecurePay_Onboarding_Checklist.docx) — feel free to flag any items that need more info.

Thanks,
Danielle Ortiz
Legal Operations
SecurePay Inc.

Attachments: SecurePay_Onboarding_Checklist.docx

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@securepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPA template + subprocessors + EU transfer approach

Hi Danielle — great to hear from you, and thanks for the checklist.

Attaching the current DPA we use for commercial customers (redwood_DPA_v3.pdf) and our subprocessor matrix (subprocessor_matrix_20270510.csv). High-level answers now:
- Subprocessors: full list attached; most infra providers are in US, EU, and APAC; we highlight any that process EU personal data in the CSV.
- EU->US transfers: we operate under the EU SCCs and maintain documented transfer mechanisms; we can provide the executed SCCs as an addendum if you need them signed separately.
- Execution: we support DocuSign primarily but can use AdobeSign for enterprise compliance — whichever SecurePay prefers.

Quick ask: do you have a standard redline process (markups in PDF vs tracked Word)? If SecurePay will propose changes to Clause 7 (subprocessor notice) or Clause 11 (data return/destruction), please highlight those so we can route to Privacy Counsel quickly.

Ben (cc) will coordinate the contract path and Jonas/Evelyn are on standby for any legal ops questions.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_DPA_v3.pdf; subprocessor_matrix_20270510.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@securepay.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPA template + subprocessors + EU transfer approach

Hi Danielle — looping in to keep timelines tight.

Plan suggestion: if SecurePay is OK with the attached redwood_DPA_v3, we can route for DocuSign and aim for signature within 3 business days; if you return redlines I'll get legal engaged immediately. Our typical flow:
1) Confirm preferred signature platform (DocuSign/AdobeSign) and signer details.
2) Receive any customer redlines (PDF or Word).
3) We review and respond within 48 hours; critical redlines will route to Privacy Counsel (Jonas).

Jonas — if Clause 7 is flagged, can you prioritize? Evelyn — please prep the standard SCC addendum language we use for US-bound transfers.

Danielle — can you confirm who will sign on SecurePay's side and the name/email for the DocuSign envelope? Also sharing our HubSpot deal link so we can keep procurement notes in one place: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8371

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@securepay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LegalOps SecurePay <legalops@securepay.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPA template + subprocessors + EU transfer approach

Thanks — quick update from our side.

We prefer DocuSign. Signer will be: Jason Lee (CFO) — j.lee@securepay.com. I've attached a redline of your DPA (securepay_redlines_v1.pdf); the only substantive ask is to add a 30-day notice requirement for new subprocessors in Clause 7 and to tighten the data return clause to specify 60 days rather than 90. Everything else is comment-level.

If you can accept the 30-day notice we can proceed with the DocuSign envelope today; otherwise we'll expect a short counter and try to stay within the week timeline.

DocuSign envelope link: https://na1.docusign.net/recipient/ABC1234

— Danielle
Danielle Ortiz
Legal Operations
SecurePay Inc.
